notifications.title: EPFO Central Board approves PF withdrawal and EDLI changes at 240th meeting
notifications.summary: The Central Board of Trustees, chaired by the Union Labour Minister, approved a Systematic Withdrawal Plan for retiring members, cut the balance that must stay in the EPF account from 25% to 10%, and reduced the wait for final withdrawal from 12 months to 2 months. It also approved amendments to the EDLI Scheme, 2026 giving exempted establishments six months to renew expired exemptions. The scheme changes take effect only after the Labour Ministry notifies them.
notifications.effective: After notification by the Labour Ministry
notifications.authority: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation

notifications.title: Maharashtra Wage Rules, 2026 in force
notifications.summary: Maharashtra’s rules under the Code on Wages replace the Minimum Wages and Payment of Wages Rules of 1963. Minimum wages are fixed per day (monthly = daily × 26), VDA is revised every April and October, deductions are capped at 50% of wages, wage slips are due on or before payday, and records must be kept for five years.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised with VDA under the Code on Wages
notifications.summary: Notification S.O. 252 under the Code on Wages (Bihar) Rules, 2026 revises minimum wages, including VDA based on the January–June 2026 CPI, for scheduled employments, and sets revised piece rates for 12 employments. Unskilled workers get ₹443 a day. The rates are provisional until approved by the State Advisory Board.
notifications.authority: Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar

notifications.title: Holiday list for 2027 published
notifications.summary: Goa notified its 2027 holidays: 18 public holidays for government offices, 9 commercial and industrial holidays, and 18 bank holidays under Section 25 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, plus special and restricted holidays.
notifications.authority: General Administration Department, Government of Goa

notifications.title: ESIC New Amnesty Scheme extended to 31 December 2026
notifications.summary: ESIC extended its New Amnesty Scheme, 2025 by three months on the same terms. Employers can settle cases filed under Sections 75 and 82 of the ESI Act, and criminal cases against employers and insured persons can be withdrawn.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment / ESIC

notifications.title: Code on Wages (Chhattisgarh) Rules, 2026 notified
notifications.summary: The final rules replace the Minimum Wages (Chhattisgarh) Rules, 1958 and the Payment of Wages Rules, 1962. They cover minimum wage calculation, twice-yearly VDA (1 April and 1 October), working hours and weekly rest, limits on deductions, claims, wage slips and inspections.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Chhattisgarh
notifications.notification_no: No. RULE-5/15/2026-LABOUR dated 28 October 2026 (Chhattisgarh Rajpatra Extraordinary No. 649)

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised from 1 October 2026
notifications.summary: Uttar Pradesh raised VDA for the half-year to March 2027. Unskilled workers get ₹13,883.59 a month in Category I (Gautam Buddha Nagar and Ghaziabad), ₹13,189.68 in Category II (Nagar Nigam districts) and ₹12,530.25 elsewhere.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

notifications.title: Negotiable Instruments Act holidays for 2027
notifications.summary: Kerala published 18 holidays for 2027 under the Negotiable Instruments Act (G.O. (P) No. 20/2026/GAD), in addition to second Saturdays and Sundays. Establishments under labour laws follow the Kerala Industrial Establishments (National and Festival Holidays) Act instead.
notifications.authority: General Administration Department, Government of Kerala

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised for shops and commercial establishments
notifications.summary: Kerala revised minimum wages for employees of shops and commercial establishments (Notification No. DES/816/2026-P3(1)), with effect from 1 September 2026. Check the notification for category-wise rates.
notifications.authority: Labour Commissionerate, Government of Kerala

notifications.title: VDA revised for all scheduled employments
notifications.summary: Jharkhand set VDA at 11.65% of basic wages from 1 October 2026 across Areas A, B and C. Unskilled workers in Area A (Ranchi, Dhanbad, Jamshedpur and other municipal corporations) get ₹13,586 a month (₹523 a day).
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Jharkhand

notifications.title: Holiday list for 2027 published
notifications.summary: Bihar notified 12 general holidays for 2027, up to three optional holidays, public holidays under the Negotiable Instruments Act, and a bank account closing holiday on 1 April 2027.
notifications.authority: General Administration Department, Government of Bihar

notifications.title: VDA revised for 57 scheduled employments
notifications.summary: Uttarakhand set VDA at ₹634 a month across 57 scheduled employments, including shops and commercial establishments, for October 2026 to March 2027. Unskilled shop workers in cities of 1 lakh or more get ₹13,173 a month.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand

notifications.title: VDA raised by ₹6 a day
notifications.summary: Odisha raised VDA by ₹6 a day for all skill categories in all scheduled employments. Unskilled workers now get ₹478 a day (about ₹12,428 a month).
notifications.authority: Labour Directorate, Government of Odisha

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised with VDA under the Code on Wages
notifications.summary: Meghalaya notified new minimum wages including VDA, replacing its May 2026 notification. Unskilled workers get ₹564 a day. Hours stay at 8 a day and 48 a week, with overtime at twice the ordinary rate.
notifications.authority: Government of Meghalaya (Official Gazette)

notifications.title: Minimum wages for October 2026 to March 2027
notifications.summary: The Labour Commissioner, Gujarat announced minimum wages for Scheduled Employment I (46 establishments and factories, including ship-breaking) and Scheduled Employment II (sweeping and cleaning). Unskilled workers in Zone I get ₹524.50 a day and in Zone II ₹513.50 a day.
notifications.authority: Labour and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat

notifications.title: Labour Commissioner orders strict enforcement of minimum wages
notifications.summary: The Labour Commissioner directed field officers to enforce the minimum wage rates notified on 9 April 2026 in all establishments, including petty establishments, with no exemption for size. A PIL on non-implementation is before the Punjab and Haryana High Court.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Haryana

notifications.title: VDA raised by ₹150 a month
notifications.summary: Madhya Pradesh raised VDA by ₹150 a month for all scheduled employments for October 2026 to March 2027. Unskilled workers in Khand-B employments (including shops, hotels and construction) get ₹12,575 a month; Khand-A textile, apparel and footwear workers get ₹10,950.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

notifications.title: VDA revised for central sphere minimum wages
notifications.summary: The Labour Bureau revised the Variable Dearness Allowance for central sphere employments (central PSUs, railways, mines, ports, airports and others), based on the rise in CPI-IW to 431.42. Unskilled construction and maintenance work in Area A rises to ₹840 a day (₹523 basic + ₹317 VDA).
notifications.authority: Chief Labour Commissioner (Central)

notifications.title: VDA and minimum wages revised from 1 October 2026
notifications.summary: Andhra Pradesh notified revised VDA and minimum wages (Notification No. G/3186486/2026) for the scheduled employments listed in the notification.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

notifications.title: Uttarakhand Code on Wages Rules, 2026 published
notifications.summary: The Uttarakhand Labour Department published the Uttarakhand Code on Wages Rules, 2026, which put the Code on Wages, 2019 into operation in the state. The rules replace the earlier minimum wages and payment of wages rules, so employers in Uttarakhand should move wage registers, wage slips and returns to the new formats.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand

notifications.title: Uttarakhand Industrial Relations Rules, 2026 published
notifications.summary: The Uttarakhand Labour Department published the Uttarakhand Industrial Relations Rules, 2026 under the Industrial Relations Code, 2020. They cover standing orders, grievance redressal, notices of change, lay-off, retrenchment and closure procedures for establishments in the state.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand

notifications.title: ESI Act extended to further areas
notifications.summary: Notification S.O. 5206(E) brings more districts under the ESI scheme. Establishments in the notified areas must start paying employer and employee contributions, and their employees become eligible for ESI benefits. Check the notification for the districts covered.
notifications.authority: Employees’ State Insurance Corporation

notifications.title: EPF wage ceiling raised to ₹25,000 a month
notifications.summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment raised the wage ceiling for EPF coverage from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 a month under the Code on Social Security, 2020, the first revision since 2014. About 51 lakh more employees come under PF, pension and EDLI cover. Employers must contribute on the revised ceiling and update payroll.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India (Gazette of India)

notifications.title: Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2026
notifications.summary: Karnataka notified the Shops and Commercial Establishments (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Karnataka Act No. 38 of 2026). Employers in Karnataka should review the amended provisions against their registrations, registers and working-hour practices.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Karnataka

notifications.title: UP OSH Rules, 2026 notified
notifications.summary: Uttar Pradesh notified its final rules under the OSH Code, replacing the state's Factories, Contract Labour, Inter-State Migrant Workmen, Welfare Officer, Safety Officer and Building Workers rules. They cover registration of establishments, factory licences, safety committees, health check-ups, contract labour and returns, and apply from publication.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

notifications.title: UP Code on Social Security Rules, 2026 notified
notifications.summary: Uttar Pradesh notified its final rules under the Code on Social Security, replacing the state's old employees' compensation, maternity benefit, gratuity, building workers and unorganised workers rules. They also set up the state Unorganised Workers Social Security Board and Building Workers Welfare Board, and apply from publication.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

notifications.title: Mandatory online registration under the OSH Code
notifications.summary: The Labour Commissioner, Gujarat directed factories, plantations and industrial and commercial establishments with 10 or more workers to register on the Shram Setu portal. New establishments have 50 days to register; existing ones must update their certificate within 180 days. Non-registration or false information can attract fines of ₹2–3 lakh.
notifications.authority: Office of the Labour Commissioner, Gujarat

notifications.title: Bonus eligibility set at ₹21,000 and calculation ceiling at ₹7,000
notifications.summary: Two notifications under the Code on Wages (S.O. 4710(E) and 4711(E)) make employees earning up to ₹21,000 a month eligible for statutory bonus. Where wages exceed ₹7,000, bonus is calculated on ₹7,000 or the central minimum wage, whichever is higher. Both apply retrospectively from 21 November 2025.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

notifications.title: Shops may stay open all 365 days for three more years
notifications.summary: Shops and establishments may open every day of the year for a further three years, provided each employee gets a weekly holiday by rotation, hours stay within 8 a day and 48 a week (57 with overtime), wages are paid into bank accounts, and women work after 8 pm only with written consent, safety measures and transport.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

notifications.title: Risk-based inspection scheme under the Labour Codes
notifications.summary: Bihar now selects establishments for inspection by computerised risk assessment. Low-risk units may self-certify, medium-risk units need third-party certification and high-risk units are inspected; monthly inspection lists are shared 72 hours in advance.
notifications.authority: Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar

notifications.title: Code on Wages (Rajasthan) Rules, 2026 finalised
notifications.summary: Rajasthan published its final rules under the Code on Wages (S.O. 40), along with final Industrial Relations rules. Employers in Rajasthan should move wage records, slips and returns to the new formats.
notifications.authority: Department of Labour, Government of Rajasthan

notifications.title: UP Code on Wages Rules, 2026 notified
notifications.summary: Uttar Pradesh notified its rules under the Code on Wages (No. 1377/XXXVI-03-2026-1901341), which now govern minimum wages, payment of wages and related records in the state.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh

notifications.title: New Professional Tax schedule for salaried employees
notifications.summary: Notification No. 756-L replaces the PT schedule. Monthly salary up to ₹20,000 is now exempt (previously ₹10,000). Tax is ₹100 a month from ₹20,001 to ₹30,000, ₹140 from ₹30,001 to ₹50,000, ₹170 from ₹50,001 to ₹1,00,000 and ₹208 above ₹1,00,000.
notifications.authority: Finance Department, Government of West Bengal

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised for July to December 2026
notifications.summary: The Labour Commissioner, Maharashtra published revised monthly minimum wages for scheduled employments in Circles I, II and III, by skill category, for the half-year from July.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra

notifications.title: Draft West Bengal OSH Rules, 2026 published
notifications.summary: Draft rules under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code cover online registration, annual health check-ups, appointment letters, safety committees for 500+ workers, registers, and annual returns due by the last day of February. Comments were invited until 27 August 2026.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

notifications.title: Bihar Gazette notifications under the Code on Wages
notifications.summary: The Labour Resources Department published notifications under the Code on Wages, 2019 in the Bihar Gazette (Extraordinary) Nos. 844–850, alongside separate gazette notifications under the Industrial Relations Code and the Code on Social Security, as Bihar puts the Labour Codes into operation.
notifications.authority: Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar

notifications.title: Draft West Bengal Code on Wages Rules, 2026 published
notifications.summary: The state published draft rules to implement the Code on Wages, 2019, covering minimum wages, payment of wages, bonus, deductions, records and inspections. Employers and industry bodies were invited to comment.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal
notifications.notification_no: No. Labr/103/Law dated 13 July 2026 (Kolkata Gazette Extraordinary SAR-354)

notifications.title: New EPF, EPS and EDLI Schemes, 2026 notified
notifications.summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, Employees' Pension Scheme and EDLI Scheme, 2026 were notified under the Code on Social Security, replacing the schemes under the old EPF Act. They also carry three special windows: the Employees' Enrolment Campaign, VISHWAS and the PF trust Amnesty.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

notifications.title: PF trust Amnesty open until 28 December 2026
notifications.summary: Establishments running PF trusts that are recognised under the Income Tax Act but lack an EPFO exemption order can regularise them retrospectively under the Amnesty, 2026. Applications close on 28 December 2026; without regularisation, the trust's income-tax recognition is at risk.
notifications.authority: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation
notifications.notification_no: Amnesty, 2026 under the EPF Scheme, 2026; EPFO circular dated 11 July 2026

notifications.title: MCD merges trade licence with property tax
notifications.summary: MCD has done away with the separate General Trade and Storage Licence application. The licence fee (15% of the property tax payable on the premises) is now paid with annual property tax on the MCD property tax portal, and the payment receipt serves as the licence. Health trade licences, such as for food businesses, remain separate.
notifications.authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi

notifications.title: Minimum wages for shops and establishments, July to December 2026
notifications.summary: Revised rates for shops and establishments apply from 1 July to 31 December 2026. Unskilled workers in Zone A (municipal corporations, municipalities and development authority areas) get ₹10,558 a month or ₹406 a day.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised across all scheduled employments
notifications.summary: The Telangana government revised minimum wages across all scheduled employments with effect from 1 June 2026.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Telangana

notifications.title: Shops and establishments with 20 or more workers may open 24x7
notifications.summary: West Bengal allowed registered shops and establishments employing 20 or more persons to operate round the clock for three years from publication in the Gazette, subject to the conditions in the notification. Employers using it should check the notification’s conditions on working hours, weekly rest and records.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of West Bengal

notifications.title: Trade licence fees revised for the first time since 2017
notifications.summary: The Department of Local Self-Government set new trade licence fees by type of urban local body, with some rising up to five times (for example, gyms now pay ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 a year and hotels with up to 50 rooms ₹15,000 to ₹25,000). Premises without a valid licence may be sealed and fined up to ₹5,000.
notifications.authority: Local Self Government Department, Government of Rajasthan

notifications.title: Final minimum wages for 81 scheduled employments
notifications.summary: Karnataka’s final notification moves to three zones and covers 81 scheduled employments with immediate effect. Unskilled workers get ₹25,714.07 a month in Zone 1 (Bengaluru and other high-cost areas), ₹23,376.43 in Zone 2 and ₹21,251.30 in Zone 3.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Karnataka

notifications.title: Central Rules notified under all four Labour Codes
notifications.summary: The Centre notified its rules under the Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and OSH Codes. They bring online registration, digital registers and e-returns, Grievance Redressal Committees for establishments with 20 or more workers, and annual health check-ups for specified workers.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment

notifications.title: LWF contribution cap revised
notifications.summary: The employee contribution remains 0.2% of monthly wages, with the cap raised from ₹34 to ₹35 a month. The employer contributes twice the employee’s share.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Haryana

notifications.title: Aggregators must report gig and platform workers on e-Shram
notifications.summary: Under the Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026, aggregators must submit details of the gig and platform workers they engage on the government portal, electronically or by API. The Code also provides for aggregator contributions of 1–2% of annual turnover, capped at 5% of payouts to workers, towards a social security fund.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

notifications.title: Minimum wages revised under the Code on Wages
notifications.summary: Punjab raised its base minimum wages by about 15%, the first base revision since 2012, by a notification under the Code on Wages. Unskilled workers now get ₹518.69 a day (₹13,486 a month) and highly skilled workers ₹638.50 a day (₹16,601 a month). The notification replaces the old March/September cycle.
notifications.authority: Labour Department, Government of Punjab

notifications.title: Professional Tax abolished
notifications.summary: An ordinance repealed Odisha’s Professional Tax with retrospective effect. No PT is payable from 1 April 2026; arrears for earlier periods can still be recovered.
notifications.authority: Commissionerate of CT & GST, Government of Odisha

notifications.title: PT returns deemed filed on payment
notifications.summary: An amendment to the Karnataka PT Act treats an enrolled person who pays the year’s tax as having filed the return, and lets the Commissioner exempt classes of enrolled persons from filing returns.
notifications.authority: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka

notifications.title: Profession Tax due dates brought forward to the 15th
notifications.summary: The Finance Department amended Rule 11(3): payments and returns that were due on the last day of the month are now due on the 15th (for example, 15 March instead of 31 March).
notifications.authority: State Tax Department, Government of Maharashtra

notifications.title: Dearness allowance for 2026-27 notified
notifications.summary: Tamil Nadu notified the DA payable from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 (No. Z3/3459/2026). For shops and commercial establishments, monthly DA rises to ₹7,353. Employers must add it to the basic rates for each zone.
notifications.authority: Office of the Commissioner of Labour, Tamil Nadu

notifications.title: Kolkata Municipal Corporation revises trade licence fees
notifications.summary: KMC revised its trade licence (certificate of enlistment) fees, mostly upward, for the first time in about 15 years, alongside fully online issue and renewal. Businesses in Kolkata should check the new rate for their category at renewal.
notifications.authority: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
notifications.notification_no: KMC Licence Department rate chart, Rates, Taxes, Fees & Charges for 2026-27

notifications.title: Bengaluru trade licence renewal for 2026-27 opens
notifications.summary: The Greater Bengaluru Authority opened online renewals from 1 February. Renewals in February carry no penalty, in March a 25% penalty, and from 1 April a 100% penalty. Licences can be renewed for one to five years, and renewals are refused for some premises, such as businesses on narrow residential roads set up after 2015.
notifications.authority: Greater Bengaluru Authority (BBMP)

notifications.title: LWF now covers establishments with 10 or more employees
notifications.summary: The Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2025, in force from 7 January 2026, lowers the coverage threshold from more than 50 employees to 10 or more. Smaller establishments that were exempt must now register and pay the existing annual contributions.
notifications.authority: Karnataka Labour Welfare Board

notifications.title: GHMC sets trade licence renewal deadlines for 2026
notifications.summary: Hyderabad businesses had to renew trade licences for 2026 by 20 December 2025 to avoid a penalty. Renewals up to 19 February 2026 attract a 25% penalty and later renewals 50%.
notifications.authority: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation

notifications.title: Four Labour Codes come into force
notifications.summary: The Code on Wages, the Industrial Relations Code, the Code on Social Security and the OSH Code replaced 29 central labour laws. States are notifying their own rules in stages.
notifications.authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment (Press Information Bureau)

notifications.title: Cap on trade licence fees charged by urban local bodies
notifications.summary: The Urban Development and Municipal Affairs department told all urban local bodies not to charge more than the legal maximum: ₹1,500 a year in municipalities and notified areas, and ₹2,500 a year in municipal corporations, including Kolkata and Howrah.
notifications.authority: Urban Development & Municipal Affairs Department, Government of West Bengal

archive.title: September 2026 ECR and PF due date extended to 31 October
archive.summary: Because the EPF wage ceiling rose to ₹25,000 in the middle of September, EPFO gave employers until 31 October 2026 to file the September 2026 ECR and deposit PF contributions. The relief applies to the September wage month only; later months stay due on the 15th.
archive.archived_reason: Expired – the extended due date (31 Oct 2026) has passed

archive.title: Employees’ Enrolment Campaign 2026 (now closed)
archive.summary: EPFO let employers declare eligible employees who were left out of PF between 1 April 2009 and 31 March 2026, with the employee share waived where it was never deducted and damages limited to ₹100 per establishment. Declarations closed on 31 October 2026.
archive.archived_reason: Expired – the campaign closed on 31 Oct 2026
